audit_items.proof_trace: The sole mutation path for borrow_index.value is set_value(), which asserts assert!(self.value.le(value)) — aborting any non-monotonic update. The formula in reserve::accrue_interest computes new = prior * (1 + rate * dt) where rate is a Decimal (u256, always ≥ 0) and dt is u64 (Move checked arithmetic aborts if now < last_updated), so new ≥ prior is mathematically guaranteed. Even with Decimal rounding truncation, floor(rate * dt * prior) + prior ≥ prior holds.
